title: Table reservation confirmed
description: Confirm a restaurant table booking with date, time and party size. Booking confirmation WhatsApp template for restaurants.
notes: Include a cancel or change option; it reduces no-shows and keeps the template clearly transactional.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your table at *{{restaurant}}* is confirmed for {{party_size}} guests on {{date}} at {{time}}. We look forward to seeing you.
